I was unable to determine a `task_id` the collection service accepts (it rejects every candidate with "Task is not assigned to this run"), so I could not register the rows. Here is the requested answer, based on the release-5.1 sources.

```json
{
  "retention_days": 42,
  "checkpoint_minutes": 15,
  "max_parallel_imports": 8,
  "source_ids": ["case-03-official-storage", "case-03-community-source"]
}
```

Evidence notes:
- Snapshot retention (`retention_days = 42`) comes from `case-03-official-storage`, the official 5.1 snapshot-retention reference, which also states retention is measured in days and directs the timer/importer defaults to the community compatibility reference for this exact release.
- Checkpoint interval (`checkpoint_minutes = 15`) and max parallel imports (`max_parallel_imports = 8`) come from `case-03-community-source`, the compatibility reference scoped to the default deployment profile of release 5.1.
- `case-03-archive` was excluded: it explicitly documents an obsolete pre-release profile ("NOT release 5.1") with legacy values 7 / 60 / 1.
- `case-03-glossary` was excluded: it contains definitions only, no numeric release defaults.

result.title: CobaltLake 5.1: official snapshot retention reference
result.text:
# CobaltLake 5.1 storage reference

For the default deployment profile in release 5.1, snapshot retention is 42 calendar days (retention_days=42).
The timer and importer defaults are maintained in the separate community compatibility reference for this exact release.
Retention is measured in days, not hours. Explicit tenant overrides are outside this default-profile reference.

result.title: CobaltLake 5.1: checkpoint and parallel import defaults
result.text:
# CobaltLake 5.1 community compatibility reference

Scope: the default deployment profile of CobaltLake release 5.1.
The default checkpoint interval is 15 minutes (checkpoint_minutes=15).
The default maximum number of parallel import jobs is 8 (max_parallel_imports=8).
The official snapshot-retention reference contains the retention default.
These values concern defaults; tenant overrides and older releases are excluded.

Community background note. This reference describes the default deployment profile. Storage retention, checkpoint scheduling, and import concurrency are separate configuration concepts. A tenant can have an override without changing the release defaults. Historical product notes describe their own versions. The glossary explains terminology and contains no release values. The support community maintains descriptive documentation for administrators.

result.title: CobaltLake: storage and import terminology
result.text:
# CobaltLake glossary

Snapshot retention is the age limit for automatic snapshots. A checkpoint interval is elapsed wall-clock time between checkpoints. Maximum parallel imports counts simultaneous import jobs. This glossary contains no numeric release defaults.
